name: mechagent-bridge
description: Observe Create and use scoped construction on NeoForge 21.1.248 for Minecraft 1.21.1.
long_description: Install the MechAgent Bridge JAR from https://github.com/Rxwkovo/mcBridge/releases. Use a local read-only token for observation.

token.title: Bridge token (optional)
token.description: Only if the mod does not write ~/.mcpfabric/bridge.json (writeDiscoveryFile: false): the token from config/mcpfabric.config.json.

url.title: Bridge address
url.description: Used together with the token above.

toolsets.title: Tool sets (optional)
toolsets.description: Use world,readonly for observation, or select tool groups supported by your setup.
